name: Bank of Baroda Limited
summary: Bank of Baroda Limited provides various banking products and services to individuals, government departments, and corporate customers in India and internationally. It operates through Treasury, Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking Operations segments. The company offers savings, salary, and current accounts; and fixed and recurring deposits.
